description: Independently constructed unseen NLP benchmark for PortiQ evaluation.

questions.question: How many active funds do we manage right now?

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portfolios WHERE status='Active'

questions.question: What is the total AUM of our passive index strategies? Return one value.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT SUM(total_aum) FROM portfolios WHERE strategy_type='Index'

questions.question: List all portfolios that have a High target risk level, ordered alphabetically.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios WHERE target_risk_level='High' ORDER BY portfolio_name

questions.question: Which funds are classified as Low risk? Return their names and AUM, lowest AUM first.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT portfolio_name,total_aum FROM portfolios WHERE target_risk_level='Low' ORDER BY total_aum ASC

questions.question: Find the single portfolio with the largest AUM in the entire universe. Return portfolio_name and total_aum.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT portfolio_name,total_aum FROM portfolios ORDER BY total_aum DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the average AUM across all active portfolios? Return a single value.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT AVG(total_aum) FROM portfolios WHERE status='Active'

questions.question: Count portfolios by strategy_type. Return strategy_type and count, sorted alphabetically by strategy.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT strategy_type,COUNT(*) FROM portfolios GROUP BY strategy_type ORDER BY strategy_type

questions.question: What is the total market value of all Stock holdings in Conservative Income Fund using quantity times current price? Return one value.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT SUM(h.quantity*s.current_price) FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON h.security_id=s.security_id WHERE h.portfolio_id=2 AND s.asset_type='Stock'

questions.question: Which portfolios hold more than 5 distinct holdings? List portfolio_name and holding count, highest first (break ties alphabetically by portfolio name).

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT p.portfolio_name,COUNT(h.holding_id) FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON p.portfolio_id=h.portfolio_id GROUP BY p.portfolio_id,p.portfolio_name HAVING COUNT(h.holding_id)>5 ORDER BY COUNT(h.holding_id) DESC,p.portfolio_name

questions.question: List symbol, company_name and current_price for securities with current_price greater than 200, highest price first.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT symbol,company_name,current_price FROM securities WHERE current_price>200 ORDER BY current_price DESC

questions.question: Which portfolios do not hold any bonds? Return portfolio names alphabetically.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios WHERE portfolio_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT h.portfolio_id FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON h.security_id=s.security_id WHERE s.asset_type='Bond') ORDER BY portfolio_name

questions.question: List the symbols of all non-Technology stocks held in Tech Innovation Fund, alphabetically.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT s.symbol FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON h.security_id=s.security_id JOIN sectors sec ON s.sector_id=sec.sector_id WHERE h.portfolio_id=3 AND s.asset_type='Stock' AND sec.sector_name!='Technology' ORDER BY s.symbol

questions.question: What is the earliest recorded transaction_date in the system? Return one value.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT MIN(transaction_date) FROM transactions

questions.question: What is the total fees paid across all SELL transactions? Return one value.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT SUM(fees) FROM transactions WHERE transaction_type='SELL'

questions.question: What are the top 3 securities by current_price in Healthcare? Return symbol, company_name, current_price, highest price first.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT s.symbol,s.company_name,s.current_price FROM securities s JOIN sectors sec ON s.sector_id=sec.sector_id WHERE sec.sector_name='Healthcare' ORDER BY s.current_price DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Which portfolios hold shares of Microsoft (MSFT)? Return portfolio names alphabetically.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT p.portfolio_name FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON p.portfolio_id=h.portfolio_id JOIN securities s ON h.security_id=s.security_id WHERE s.symbol='MSFT' ORDER BY p.portfolio_name

questions.question: Calculate total cost_basis by asset_type across all holdings, sorted by asset_type.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT s.asset_type,SUM(h.cost_basis) FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON h.security_id=s.security_id GROUP BY s.asset_type ORDER BY s.asset_type

questions.question: What is the total quantity of Apple (AAPL) shares held across all portfolios? Return one value.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT SUM(h.quantity) FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON h.security_id=s.security_id WHERE s.symbol='AAPL'

questions.question: Return portfolio_name and total_aum for portfolios with Index strategy_type, sorted by portfolio_name.
